name: Image dropzone
summary: The full-width settings image field where the image IS the field — a dashed upload card with empty / loading / filled states and a Change/Edit/Delete overlay; it emits intents, the host owns the modals (SETTINGS-44).
highlights: Settings image field where the image is the field
Dashed upload card with empty, loading and filled states
Emits intents; the host owns the modals
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-image-dropzone> — the standalone MAIN image field where the image IS the field: a background/hero image, an interactive-image base, a picture reveal (SETTINGS-44). NOT the per-option ImageActionButton. Three states: empty (a full-width dashed upload card, 8px corners), loading (a spinner at the SAME height as the empty card so the panel does not jump), and filled (the image fitted in a display box with a Change / Edit / Delete overlay on hover). It OWNS no modals — it EMITS intents (`add` / `change` / `edit` / `delete`) and the host runs the upload/crop/confirm flow. Glyphs are summoned by name via <aha-icon>. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. Wire the host to the intents; drive `state`/`src` from the host's upload flow. React (< 19) via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively.

spec.label: Empty
spec.value: 2px dashed #D4D4D4 card, centred system-image-square (16px #4A4A4A) + the label 14/21 #1A1A1A (text-default), and with `hint` a second line 14/21 #4A4A4A (text-secondary), as the settings lab (PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP) — the lab's #8A8A8A is 3.22:1 on the #F7F7F7 fill, under the 4.5:1 text floor; click emits `add`

spec.label: Loading
spec.value: 24px #E70E68 spinner at the SAME 120 min-height — the panel does not jump

spec.label: Filled
spec.value: fixed 135px frame, 1px #E3E3E3 border, radius 8, overflow hidden; image fitted (fit=contain default | cover) + hover Change/Edit/Delete overlay (a 50% black scrim, rgba(0,0,0,.5))

spec.label: Intents
spec.value: add · change · edit · delete — host owns the modals, this owns none

spec.label: Hover
spec.value: empty and loading: the dashed edge turns Vivid Pink 30% (vivid-pink-30, #E70E684D); fill, label, hint and icon unchanged. Filled: #E70E68 border (border-hover) under the overlay

props.name: state
props.desc: The field's state — drives which affordance shows, at a constant box height

props.name: fit
props.desc: How the filled image sits in the box — contain (whole image, letterboxed) or cover (fill, cropped)

props.name: label
props.desc: The empty-state prompt text (the first line, text-default)

props.name: hint
props.desc: Optional second line under the label, in text-secondary: accepted formats or size, e.g. PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP

props.name: add / change / edit / delete
props.desc: Composed intents — the host runs the corresponding modal/flow

opinion.note: The MAIN image field is this dropzone — NOT a hand-rolled "Add image"/"Replace image" button plus a separate "Remove image" danger button (SETTINGS-44). The loading state matches the empty card's height so the panel doesn't jump. It emits intents; the host owns the upload/crop modals.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — the settings-lab ImageDropzone control mapped into the DS. The dashed card, overlay and states reuse DS V3 tokens; the full-width image-field shape + no-jump loading + intent events are the settings-specific behaviour (SETTINGS-44).
